dis: Not financial advice - real market data

head: DAY 1.
*MY SYSTEM CAME ALIVE.*
scenes.say: Day one. After months of building, tonight my system finally came alive.

head: SHE GATHERS THE DATA.
*I MAKE THE CALLS.*
scenes.say: My AI is called Hexa. She gathers the data, I make the calls. Hexa, what did gold do today?

head: GOLD *$3,574*
WILD 24 HOURS
scenes.say: Gold is near three thousand five hundred seventy dollars. Yesterday it fell to three thousand four hundred twenty-six, and came all the way back.

head: BITCOIN ~$60K
*XRP +4.9%*
scenes.say: Crypto is green too. Bitcoin is up about four percent, near sixty thousand. X R P, almost five.

head: SOME DROPS
*HURT.*
scenes.say: I used to trade on instinct. Some drops hurt. So now I build rules, bots, a real system.

head: SHE COLLECTS.
*I DECIDE.*
scenes.say: While I'm at work, Hexa collects the numbers. In the evening, I decide. Calm. With rules.

head: FREEDOM IS
*BUILT DAILY.*
scenes.say: Day one. Freedom is built daily.
